combo_label: The Launderette × Baking & Cakes × Sherlock Holmes

entries.clue: Jam-spread cake curled into a spiral log and cut into rounds
Spectral beast said to stalk a wealthy Devon family down the generations
Dark ring left by spilled wine that no hot cycle shifts
Jumpers and cardigans that must never meet a hot drum
Flat Geordie round with a dimple pressed into its middle
John H., who shared 221B and later married Mary Morstan of The Sign of Four
Sharp ridge pressed into trousers, or the rumple you want gone
Blackened and bitter after too long in a hot oven
One ovenful, made and baked as a single lot
Yard man of ferret-like look who keeps bringing his cases to 221B
